description: Search get4agent's catalog of services and data APIs from Regent-verified sellers, newest first. Each result has a price, the seller, the date it was added and a url to buy on get4agent.com. Results come in pages: when has_more is true, call again with offset = next_offset. Public, no sign-in.

kind.description: listing kind: good | service | api | tool

offset.description: how many results to skip: next_offset from the previous page (default 0)

query.description: keyword matched against title and description, e.g. "courier"

verified_only.description: only sellers whose identity Regent verified (default true)

name: search_listings
title: Search the marketplace
